text.p: Nova Corp said Wednesday it closed a transaction with Crestar Bank to form an exclusive marketing alliance, and has acquired Crestar's merchant transaction processing business.
Terms of the acquistion were not disclosed.
Crestar is a unit of Crestar Financial Corp. Crestar Bank, headquartered in Richmond, Va., has branch locations in Virginia, Maryland and the District of Columbia.
The acquisition, said Nova, will add about $1.8 billion in annualized credit and debit card transaction processing volume to Nova's business.
Nova, based in Atlanta, is an integrated provider of transaction processing services and related software application products.
